ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Contract renewals, Review meeting and later stages need Renewal risk and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Contract_renewals", CASE(StageName, "Upcoming", 1, "Review meeting", 2, "Terms proposed", 3, "Awaiting signature", 4, "Renewed", 5, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Renewal_risk__c)), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Renewal risk and Next step date before moving to Review meeting.
